text: {"hierarchy":9,"layout_spacing":8,"typography":8,"color_contrast":8,"consistency":9,"overall":8,"reason":"A polished landing page with a bold centered headline, clear primary/secondary CTAs, and a cohesive purple palette that carries through to the browser mockup; minor weaknesses are the low-contrast subtitle and rating text and the plain caption strip at the bottom that feels disconnected from the rest of the design."}
